content: I'm curious if there is any code for triangulated categories, algebraic cycles, and/or geometric motives over Q

Please take a look yourself! :-)

(Yes, there's lots on triangulated categories. But asking good questions --- so you get good answers --- requires doing your research first.)
Thanks for your response. I'll have a deeper look.
Does this mean mathlib is the only place to look for this kind of information, and there is not a more specialized library?
Joël Riou has lots of work that is queued up to PR to mathlib (if only we could merge his already PR'd work fast enough!) but I'm not sure where he keeps that.
Thanks a lot. That's just the sort of breadcrumb I was hoping to obtain by posting.

The branch where I am developing homological algebra before adding new material to mathlib is https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/pull/25848
@Sophie Morel has done some work related to triangulated categories and Nori motives; @Raphael Douglas Giles is developing algebraic cycles.
It will take a certain time before we can formalize Voevodsky's triangulated categories of motives...
Well, given that the two modern definitions of Nori motives use Voevodsky motives, I would say that we are also far from Nori motives. :sweat_smile:
